James Howat, Member  Stephen Wood, Member

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

Chair Jim Howat, called the meeting to order at 2:00 P.M.

ROLL CALL

  Commissioners Present: Howat, Lie, Wood

Also present: Jennifer Santana, Secretary.

Roll call takem by Jennifer Santana.

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-54703  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Mayor’s Fund Subcommittee
  meeting of Monday, March 24, 2025.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Howat, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  2  Lie, Howat
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 1  Wood

2.  25-55871  Recommendation to receive and file the Mayor’s Fund Update from the Health
  Department.

  • City Staff provided updates on the May/June Mayors’s fund ending balance
  and total contributions. The available balance as of July 28, 2025 including
  outstanding MOUs is $147,067.21.

  Yes:  3  Howat, Lie, Wood

  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

3.  25-54706  Recommendation to approve the Mayor’s Fund standard operating procedures
  (SOP) verbiage updates.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Howat, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Howat, Lie, Wood
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  • The subcommittee members would like to incorporate the evaluation criteria
  into the SOP draft to ensure that organizational capacity is assessed before
  awarding funding. The draft will be presented at the Homeless Services
  Advisory Committee meeting in August.

4.  25-54709  Recommendation to review and discuss the Mayor’s Fund grant application and
  website verbiage.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Howat, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Howat, Lie, Wood
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  • The subcommittee members discussed the potential to fund a homeless
  prevention program, including conversations around shared living
  arrangements for older adults and families.
  • The subcommittee will present their ideas to the larger committee in an effort
  to explore using the funds for transitional housing and shared living spaces,

  as well as to propose adjustments to the funding cap restrictions for applying
  agencies.

5.  25-54705  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the fundraising strategies for
  the Mayor’s Fund.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Howat, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  0  None
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 3  Howat, Lie, Wood

  • Health Department staff Emily Rodriguez joined the meeting to assist with
  brainstorming fundraising strategies. Topics included revamping the
  homeless services website for the Mayor’s Fund and the Long Beach
  Community Foundation web page featuring the Mayor’s Fund.
  • The subcommittee will continue to work with staff to bring in new ideas.

6.  25-54707  Recommendation to discuss and approve future agenda items.

  A motion was made by Member Lie, seconded by Member Howat, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Howat, Lie, Wood
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  • No new items, the subcommittee will continue to work on the current agenda
  items discussed.

PUBLIC COMMENT

  • No public comment.
